label: EU Funding & Tenders Portal
terms_note: EU open data; public apiKey SEDIA; proposals submitted only through the Funding & Tenders Portal with EU Login.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (SEDIA search API). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.

endpoints.notes: results[]: reference, title, metadata (callIdentifier, deadlineDate, status, frameworkProgramme)

reference.limits: - Submission only via the portal (EU Login). - EU open data; public apiKey SEDIA; proposals submitted only through the Funding & Tenders Portal with EU Login.

me.note: Public SEDIA search with the open/forthcoming filter, one result: checks the API is reachable (no credentials; the public apiKey is SEDIA).

search_postings.note: POST /search?apiKey=SEDIA&text=… with the documented 'query' form part (typed application/json) restricting to tenders (type 0), call topics (1, 2) and cascade-funding calls (8) whose status is forthcoming (31094501) or open (31094502), English records only (languages part). `query` is required by the API — pass *** for everything. Ids are topic/tender identifiers (e.g. HORIZON-CL4-2024-DIGITAL-EMERGING-01-22). `category`/`min_budget` are not applied; the status in the index can lag the topic page.

get_posting.note: Topic Details service: search with text="<identifier>" (quoted, as documented) limited to tenders and calls in English; returns the best match's metadata (description HTML, deadline, call, budget overview JSON string, conditions under raw.metadata).

not_offered.submit_bid: The portal APIs are read-only search services ('retrieve the full list of Call of Proposals - Topics / Call for Tenders', https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis); proposals and tenders are submitted in the Funding & Tenders Portal with EU Login.
not_offered.withdraw_bid: No submission API exists (https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis lists only search services); withdrawals happen in the portal's submission system.
not_offered.bid_status: Submission status is only visible in the logged-in portal (My Proposals); the public APIs listed at https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis are search services only.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API: the public services are Grants & Tenders, Topic Details, Grant Updates, FAQ, Organisation Public Data, Partner Search and Projects & Results searches (https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis).
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API: the public services are search services only (https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis).
not_offered.credits: The portal has no credits or paid quota; the search API is public with apiKey=SEDIA (https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis).

adapter.terms: EU Funding & Tenders Portal public SEDIA Search API (apiKey=SEDIA, https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/apis). Search criteria are sent as a JSON 'query' form part, reference codes (type 0 = tenders; status 31094501 forthcoming, 31094502 open, 31094503 closed) come from the Facet API. Applications go through the portal with EU Login.
